snippet.title: Cupiclaw - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Cupiclaw, a strategy roguelike deckbuilding game developed by Typin. Players will interface with a claw machine to grab prizes, charge up a powerful combo, and ascend to the top floor of the arcade to mend a relationship in jeopardy. Cupiclaw is launching on March 5 for PC (Steam).
